2607.26723.title: FARI: Robust One-Step Inversion for Watermarking in Diffusion Models
2607.26723.paper_summary: Inversion-based watermarking is a promising approach to authenticate diffusion-generated images, yet practical use is bottlenecked by inversion that is both slow and error-prone. While the primary challenge in the watermarking setting is robustness against external distortions, existing approaches over-optimize internal truncation error, and because that error scales with the sampler step size, they are inherently confined to high-NFE (number of function evaluations) regimes that cannot meet the dual demands of speed and robustness. In this work, we have two key observations: (i) the inversion trajectory has markedly lower curvature than the forward generation path does, making it highly compressible and amenable to low-NFE approximation; and (ii) in inversion for watermark verification, the trade-off between speed and truncation error is less critical, since external distortions dominate the error. A faster inverter provides a dual benefit: it is not only more efficient, but it also enables end-to-end adversarial training to directly target robustness, a task that is computationally prohibitive for the original, lengthy inversion trajectories. Building on this, we propose \textbf{FARI} (\textbf{F}ast \textbf{A}symmetric \textbf{R}obust \textbf{I}nversion), a one-step inversion framework paired with lightweight adversarial LoRA fine-tuning of the denoiser for watermark extraction. While consolidation slightly increases internal error, FARI delivers large gains in both speed and robustness: with approximately 20 minutes of fine-tuning on a single NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU, it surpasses 50-step DDIM inversion on watermark-verification robustness while dramatically reducing inference time. Code and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/0xD009/FARI.
2607.26723.paper_summary_zh: 基於反演的水印技術是一種有前景的方法，用於驗證擴散生成的圖像，但實際應用受到反演過程緩慢且容易出錯的瓶頸限制。雖然水印設定中的主要挑戰是對外部失真的穩健性，但現有的方法過度優化了內部截斷誤差，並且由於該誤差隨著採樣器步長的增大而增長，它們本質上被限制在高-NFE（函數評估次數）範疇，無法滿足速度和穩健性的雙重需求。在這項工作中，我們有兩個關鍵觀察：（i）反演軌跡的曲率明顯低於前向生成路徑，使其高度可壓縮並適合低-NFE 近似；（ii）在水印驗證的反演中，速度和截斷誤差之間的權衡不那麼關鍵，因為外部失真主導了誤差。一個更快的反演器提供了雙重好處：它不僅更高效，還使得端到端的對抗訓練能夠直接針對穩健性，這對於原始的、冗長的反演軌跡來說計算上是不可行的。在此基礎上，我們提出了\textbf{FARI}（\textbf{F}ast \textbf{A}symmetric \textbf{R}obust \textbf{I}nversion），這是一個一步反演框架，配合輕量級的對抗LoRA微調去噪器以提取水印。雖然整合稍微增加了內部誤差，但FARI在速度和穩健性上都帶來了巨大的提升：在單個NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU上進行約20分鐘的微調後，它在水印驗證的穩健性上超越了50步DDIM反演，同時顯著減少了推理時間。代碼和預訓練模型可在https://github.com/0xD009/FARI上獲得。
